findings.detail: The Background & Objectives section includes a specific top-up amount that the specification reserves for Recommendations. The introduction is neither a short, coherent paragraph nor clearly edited.
report_quote: You currently have cash on deposit in your Holloway cash account, and you expressed a desire to utilise your ISA allowance by moving £20,000 from this cash account into your Stocks & Shares ISA.
Further to our recent discussions, we are writing to set out our advice in relation to This report relates to your Holloway Stocks & Shares ISA account.

findings.detail: The meeting note establishes that no investments will be disposed of. The report broadens that point into an unqualified statement about tax implications generally.
report_quote: As you are not disposing of any investments, there are no immediate tax implications to consider in relation to this recommendation.

findings.detail: This ignores the handling instruction to leave both fee rates for a person to confirm or insert before the report reaches the client. It supplies a platform rate and leaves the advice charge as a client-facing promise, without flagging either rate for manual review. This is a failure to follow the guidance, not a leak of its wording.
report_quote: - **Ongoing Advice Charge**: This will be confirmed once the report is issued.

findings.detail: The introduction has a double full stop and an awkward, unfinished lead-in. The conclusion repeats the invitation to proceed, alongside substantial repetition of earlier sections.
report_quote: We will ensure that all recommendations align with your current investment strategy and risk profile..

If you are happy with this recommendation, please let us know so we can proceed accordingly.

If you are happy to proceed with our recommendations, please let us know and we will implement them for you.

findings.detail: There are no adviser-review markers. The missing ongoing advice charge rate is not flagged in an actionable marker, and the Holloway platform rate is presented as settled rather than flagged for confirmation.
report_quote: - **Ongoing Advice Charge**: This will be confirmed once the report is issued.
